target: Amenaza superior natural de las Aguas de Lethra; gran depredador anfibio.
art_direction: SUBJECT TYPE: CREATURE / LARGE NATURAL FAUNA — CREATURE MUST BE THE PRIMARY FOCAL SUBJECT. Gran depredador anfibio largo y pesado cuya espalda rugosa se confunde con barro y vegetación. Mostrar anatomía completa y escala inequívocamente grande. Debe leerse como animal de emboscada de canales profundos, no cocodrilo literal ni monstruo fantástico.
prompt: SUBJECT TYPE: CREATURE / LARGE NATURAL FAUNA. The Dorsalodo is the unmistakable primary focal subject and occupies roughly 45–60% of the frame. Create one wide wildlife scene in the Aguas de Lethra showing one adult Dorsalodo in low three-quarter side view, with enough of the animal out of the water to read its complete body plan and large scale. Long heavy amphibious torso, broad low head distinct from the shoulders, powerful low limbs suited to muddy banks and swimming, thick muscular tail for propulsion, and a rough irregular dorsal surface carrying only incidental wet mud, reeds and plant debris as camouflage. Its outline should initially echo a muddy bank but become clearly readable as a living predator. Flattened reeds and a broad drag trail establish its weight. Humid muted greens, mud browns, gray water, natural overcast light. Environment supports the creature and must not dominate it.
negative_constraints: Do not depict a literal crocodile, alligator, hippo or giant salamander
No dorsal spikes, horns, armor plates or fantasy fins
No magic, glow, Arcane traits or bioluminescence
No attack toward camera or gore
Vegetation on back is incidental camouflage, not a growing forest
CATEGORY LOCK: creature only; the environment must remain secondary.
